summary: Aibotics Inc., a Nevada corporation, filed an 8-K on October 5, 2026 disclosing an October 2, 2026 Agreement for the Exchange of Stock to acquire 100% of Empulser Enterprises LLC, a Wyoming LLC. Consideration is up to $22,000,000 in Series C Preferred Stock (2,200,000 shares at a $10.00 original issue price), with 220,000 shares issued at closing and 1,980,000 shares subject to ten milestones over a 36-month earn-out, including $500,000 cumulative revenue. No board recommendation or advisor was named. What to watch: milestone achievement risk, dilution and Series C liquidation preference, and closing conditions.
